strings.en: Knight or not, a traitor deserves only death.
I'll present your head to Lord Karo-Ran.
I wasn't ordered to capture it unharmed.
That experimental unit has outlived its use.
Upgrading an experimental unit won't help...
No matter how big, it's just a counterfeit.
No matter how many weapons it carries...
You are all fated to disappear.
With one unit missing, you can't combine.
I won't let you break through head-on.
Eliminating the core of their forces.
Cybuster... It's no use showing up now.
I must stay wary of that one...!
An enemy Larseilam doesn't work on.../　Eliminating it swiftly.
I'll strike before it can unleash its firepower.
Adding wings and cannons won't help...
All that's left is to vanish...!
All that's left... is the darkness...!
As long as my weapons work, it's enough...!
Tch, until the retreat order comes...!
Ngh... My means of countering it are limited...!
I don't intend to die in vain...!
Ngh! As I thought, the Throne Unit is...!
If I don't hold it back in that state, there'll be trouble...!
Even the Granteed Dracodeus/　must have an opening...!
I never expected to complete my mission unscathed/　against that Throne Unit...!
To fall behind an experimental unit...!
If I can't dispose of a counterfeit...!
How did they upgrade that experimental unit/　to get that kind of power...?!
So this is the power that stood against the Vaula...!
Not bad for a dead copy...!
To be defeated by the Einst...!
I'll have to reassess that thing.
...I'll have to change how I fight.
Failing the mission is not permitted...!
It showed more power than the data indicated...
In this unit, I can't shake/　off the Raftclans...!
To pilot the Throne Unit like that...
I didn't think it'd be an easy opponent, but...!
As I thought, the Throne Unit that gained Basileus is...!
To master the Throne Unit so thoroughly...!
An experimental unit surpassing our machines...!
So it really did hold back the Vaula...!
The Grungust's power is not to be underestimated...!
Ngh, I can't read its movements!
Am I at a disadvantage in high-mobility combat...?!
Damn that Granzon, its power is bottomless...!
Was I too slow to react?
Is that all a knight's power amounts to?
This is all you can do with a Throne Unit?
It may be a Throne Unit, but there's a way to fight it.
A counterfeit is no enemy of mine.
With that size, is this/　all the damage you can deal?
Is this reaction some kind of mistake?
Damn that Vaula, its power has dropped.
I'll have to revise the Grungust's data downward.
Its performance seems to have degraded.
It's no threat unless it combines.
Impressive burst speed, but that's all.
Damn that fake Einst, it moves well.
Have I fallen into the enemy's trap...?
I have no choice but to fall back.
Did I reveal too much of my hand?
Where did that thing disappear to?
To lose sight of the enemy...
Lord Karo-Ran, leave the cleanup to me.
